description: This file contains implementation of external OpenCDM system functions, including session management, secure stop handling, and hash retrieval, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_ldl_session_limit
methods.description: Retrieves the LDL session limit from the system, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_is_secure_stop_enabled
methods.description: Logs a warning that secure stop is not supported and returns 0.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_enable_secure_stop
methods.description: Logs a warning that secure stop is not supported and returns an error.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_reset_secure_stop
methods.description: Logs a warning that reset secure stop is not supported and returns 0.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_secure_stop_ids
methods.description: Logs a warning that getting secure stop IDs is not supported and returns an error.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_secure_stop
methods.description: Logs a warning that getting secure stop is not supported and returns an error.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_commit_secure_stop
methods.description: Logs a warning that committing secure stop is not supported and returns an error.

methods.name: opencdm_get_key_store_hash_ext
methods.description: Retrieves the key store hash from the system, with validation, error handling, and copying to buffer.

methods.name: opencdm_get_secure_store_hash_ext
methods.description: Retrieves the secure store hash from the system, with validation, error handling, and copying to buffer.

methods.name: opencdm_delete_key_store

methods.name: opencdm_delete_secure_store
methods.description: Deletes the secure store from the system, with error handling.

methods.name: opencdm_session_set_drm_header
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for a session, with validation and error handling.
